post.description: Development compatibility endpoint. Disabled outside dev/test.

Host invites one guest to their farm.

Idempotent: re-inviting inside the existing offer's window returns the same
pending invitation rather than creating a second one.
Guest accepts: capacity checked and slot reserved in one transaction.

get.description: The caller's resolved session: owned vs current world and the mode.
Current occupancy of the caller's own farm. The owner is not counted.

delete.description: Owner kicks a visitor; the visitor is returned to their own world.

post.description: Visitor leaves: slot released and the caller returns to their own farm.

get.description:
Authoritative snapshot of the world the caller is currently in.

While visiting this is the host's farm, including its tiles, crops and
growth state. It is a read; the caller cannot change what comes back.

get.summary: All gameplay sections in one round trip
get.description:
Replaces the client's six sequential gameplay reads after each action.

Every section matches its standalone endpoint exactly, so this is additive:
the individual routes remain available and unchanged.

FarmInviteRequest.title: FarmInviteRequest
FarmInviteRequest.description:
Host names the one guest to invite.

``guest_player_id`` and ``target_id`` are accepted as the same field so the
legacy ``/social/invites`` shape keeps working, but disagreement is
rejected rather than silently preferring one.

item_type.title: Item Type
item_type.description: Deprecated output alias for older backend tools.

StateBundleResponse.title: StateBundleResponse
StateBundleResponse.description:
Everything a client needs after one round trip.

The Godot client previously fetched these six sections sequentially after
every farm action, so one interaction cost seven round trips. Every section
here is byte-identical to its standalone endpoint, so existing clients and
the individual routes keep working unchanged.
